label: 东路天皇殿展廊 · 局部通道重建
geometry: Partial Tianhuang pavilion and adjoining circulation traced from THAD 1F plan; roof, steel frame, guardrail interpreted from photos. No reconstructed relics.
accuracy: Circulation boundary comes from the published floor plan; positional and dimensional approximation, not on-site navigation.
Floor level is the local walkway datum; column/eave heights and rail section sizes estimated from photos.
Exposed archaeology is represented only by its footprint and recess. Individual relics and masonry details are not reconstructed.
This partial model is not a 360 photograph and does not establish a completed interior for all three palaces.
siteTransform: Add siteLocalOrigin to interior point then use shared/geography.mjs modelLocalToWorld with shangqing geo. Route-only viewer keeps local metres and plan north.
materials: Original procedural stone approximation, 0.6m joints estimated; not photographed/scanned PBR. Steel and aluminium use photo-guided color estimates. Three 1024 PNGs embedded.
rights: THAD architectural drawings and Wu Ji Photography reference photographs retain their original copyright. Local research study; permission not obtained for public redistribution of those originals. Model and procedural textures authored in this task; do not call this a scan or complete restoration.

build.scope: Plan-traced circulation around east Tianhuang display pavilion, partial source-based interior. Not a scan or complete archaeology reconstruction.
